```python
import polars as pl

# Create in-memory DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "user": ["alice", "bob", "charlie", "diana", "eve"],
    "amount": [50, 150, 75, 200, 120]
})

# Build deferred query
query = (
    df.lazy()
    .filter(pl.col("amount") > 100)
    .select("user")
)

# Materialize result eagerly
result = query.collect()
print(result)
```
